concerns.text: The plan cites a SRA parquet URL (https://huggingface.co/datasets/sradc/chunked-wikipedia20220301en-bookcorpusopen/resolve/main/data/train-00000-of-00053-fce5f0af789cac4c.parquet) that is a placeholder dataset unrelated to 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing. This dataset cannot provide the required ASV counts for *Arabidopsis thaliana* or *Solanum lycopersicum* under herbivore stress, making it the wrong dataset for the research question.

Running 1 000 permutation iterations, each involving a full leave‑one‑study‑out 5‑fold CV with PCA and a 500‑tree Random Forest, will likely exceed the 6‑hour wall‑clock and 7 GB RAM limits of the GitHub Actions runner (2 CPU cores). The compute demand is infeasible under the free‑compute constraints of llmXive.
